findings.title: REQ6 lifecycle scope and false attribution
findings.evidence: The four endpoints listReplicas/retainAsset/restoreAsset/listRetentionHolds are attributed to REQ3/8, while the assigned task excludes REQ6. Ordinary active metadata cannot amend requirementIds or Program identity; simple Task+Registry+Program addition is rejected.
findings.minimalRoute: Remove these four explicit lifecycle endpoints and their entry/coverage/HTTP and orphan-specific schema records, keeping assigned cache and REQ1 asset/source relationship metadata. Record future REQ6 contract scope reconciliation rather than implying GZ015 has existing contract write authority.
findings.qualification: REQ1 explicitly includes unified Replica relationships and source retention policy. Do not delete all such existing model fields or claim every read-only Replica representation is necessarily out of scope. GZ015 has no Task spec yet and its frozen outputPaths omit contracts/openapi and specs/contracts/openapi; extension needs future actual legal scope admission.

findings.title: ErrorDetails accepts promised-redacted secrets and paths
findings.evidence: Actual validate_instance accepted an ErrorDetails object containing credentialValue/sourcePath/deniedResourceId/nested providerResponse, in conflict with its own redacted bounded description.
findings.minimalRoute: Close ErrorDetails additionalProperties; retain only reviewed bounded public field/backoff context. Add arbitrary-field/nested payload negatives. Keep server redaction responsibility explicit; closed schema alone cannot prove secrecy of arbitrary allowed strings.

findings.title: Passkey discovery allows anonymous account-not-found branch
findings.evidence: Actual createPasskeyChallenge includes valid201 success and a valid404 ACCESS_NOT_FOUND example although the only optional account lookup is username and its contract promises non-disclosure. This is a contract oracle branch; no runtime server account-enumeration test was performed.
findings.minimalRoute: Remove account-not-found/other account-specific distinctions from this discovery operation, preserve truly global validation/rate-limit failures and uniform options semantics, and add operation-specific negative regression.

findings.title: Approval carrier schema disagrees with executable helper
findings.evidence: Actual PublicationRequest body and X-Approval-Id header schemas accepted usr_example01; actual protected-intent helper rejected it as invalid approval carrier.
findings.minimalRoute: Add dedicated apr_ ApprovalId schema and reuse at all approval carrier bodies/headers, approval route parameter and Approval id where relevant. Do not mutate the shared generic ResourceId YAML alias and thereby restrict unrelated resources. Add non-apr negative plus valid apr positive.

findings.title: LOCAL source root allows traversal or absolute path
findings.evidence: Actual SourceDraft validation accepted LOCAL roots ../../etc, /etc, C:\Windows and ..\private.
findings.minimalRoute: Define LOCAL-specific canonical mount/relative-root shape and reject traversal/absolute paths/separators/ambiguous encodings, while preserving valid other connector root semantics. Maintain server mount ACL/realpath/symlink checks as downstream runtime duties; add direct request negative and legitimate connector-root positives.
